question: Which of the following songs do the peasants of Rajasthan sing while working in fields?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pankhida**__.

__
 
• **Peasants of Rajasthan sing Pankhida while working in fields**__.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pankhida__**: The meaning of the pankhida is lover.

 __
 
• Pankida a folk music tradition sung by the peasants of Rajasthan while working in fields they sing and speak while playing *algoza* and *manjira.*
 
• *Algoza *is a paired woodwind instrument.
 
• *Manjira* is a traditional hand percussion instrument of India.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Folk music tradition**
 **Details**
 
 

 Pandavani
 
 
 
• It is a folk music tradition of the state Chhatisgarh.
 
• Tales from mahabharat are sung as a ballad 
 
• The main singer assumes all the characters of the chosen episodes with singing and symbolic gestures
 
 
 
 

 Chhakri
 
 
 
• It is the most popular form of folk music in Kashmir.
 
• A singer along with his chorus, instruments like Sarangi, Rabab narrates the legendary folklore stories.
 
 
 
 

 Barhamasa
 
 
 
• It is the regional music of Kumaon.
 
• It describes the twelve months of a year each with specific qualities
